data.desc: Shoe Station Group, Inc. is one of the nation's largest omnichannel family footwear retailers, offering a broad assortment of dress, casual and athletic footwear for men, women and children with an emphasis on national name brands. As of September 22, 2026, the Company operated 420 stores in 35 states and Puerto Rico under its Shoe Carnival and Shoe Station banners and offers shopping at shoecarnival.com and shoestation.com.
